message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling (both under her own name and her pseudonym Robert Galbraith):

| Title | Year | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | First book in the Harry Potter series; introduces Harry, Hogwarts, and the wizarding world. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Second book; explores the mystery of the Chamber and the basilisk. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Third book; introduces Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Fourth book; features the Triwizard Tournament and the return of Voldemort. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Fifth book; focuses on Dumbledore’s Army and the Ministry’s interference. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Sixth book; delves into Voldemort’s past and the Horcruxes. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Seventh and final book; concludes the epic battle between good and evil. |
| **Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them** | 2001 | Companion book to the Harry Potter films; a fictional textbook on magical creatures. |
| **Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald** (film tie‑in) | 2018 | Expanded universe novel based on the film’s storyline. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel published under her own name; a dark political drama set in a small town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Debut of the detective series featuring private investigator Cormoran Strike. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **The Ickabog** | 2020 | A children’s fable written during the COVID‑19 pandemic; released for free online. |

These titles represent the bulk of Rowling’s most widely read and commercially successful works. If you’re interested in a particular genre or period of her writing, let me know and I can narrow it down further!
